evidence.reason: The assertion is vacuous for the intended shared-quarantine behavior: `moved` is enqueued at `AT` (2026-10-30T00:00:00Z) but only checked on 2026-11-10T00:00:00Z, 11 days later. A 24-hour age/staleness guard in `eligible()` rejects it before family quarantine history is evaluated, so the test would still pass if the shared-quarantine check were removed. Use a younger sibling and an unquarantined control to isolate the quarantine condition.
